title: DR Pre-built Checkout
description: This is a fully JavaScript-based, embedded, customizable checkout page for client's e-commerce websites. Integrated the company's latest APIs, supporting multiple payment methods, multi-language, and cross-border tax data processing.

title: DR WordPress Plugin
description: This is an open-source plugin that integrates the company's APIs, enabling clients to quickly set up their e-commerce websites using WordPress and customize themes. It supports robust checkout features, including a complete checkout flow, promo code functionality, cross-selling and up-selling, payments, multi-language/multi-currency, and product/user management.

title: My Old Portfolio
description: This is my old portfolio, completed around 2017. It was developed using Ruby on Rails and the built files are hosted on AWS S3. The homepage uses parallax scrolling technique, the Portfolio page includes some engaging animations.

title: RGA Online & In-house Quotation System V2
description: This is a UK-based property insurance quotation system with robust features, supported by sophisticated calculation logic. It adopts a front-end and back-end separation architecture, with the front-end built as a Single Page Application (SPA) using Angular. I was responsible for the front-end architecture and UI/UX design.

title: RGA Online & In-house Quotation System V1
description: This is a UK-based property insurance quotation system designed to serve both general users and insurance brokers. It offers robust features, including various types of policy calculations, broker management, and report generation, supported by sophisticated calculation logic.

title: RGA Insurance Websites & Blogs
description: These are websites and blogs for sub-brands under RGA Insurance Group. I primarily focused on blog migration, frontend enhancements, and SEO improvements.

title: bitplay Website
description: An official website developed for bitplay Inc. We used full screen and magnetic scrolling effect to demo the company's products clearly and smoothly. Users can also see some delightful details in each page. It's a bilingual website in English and Chinese.

title: fotoON Photo Printing Service
description:
fotoON is a platform for customizing and purchasing printed products, where customers can use its photo editor to select images, specify materials and accessories, and, upon completing their orders, will have high-quality printed wall art delivered to their address.
It also integrates social media features, allowing users to register with their Facebook account and share their customized images on Facebook with a single click.

title: CTK Website
description: A parallax scrolling website with keyboard events for CTK Programming Service. The whole team collaborated on ideas and design, while I implemented the entire website, including animations and interactive effects.

title: ASUS Transformer Demo APP
description: This is an application for ASUS's All In One Transformer computer demonstration. With a lot of finger touch interactions, medias and animations written by ActionScript. This demo app was installed in every 2013 ASUS Transformer machines.

title: AMC e-Learning Series
description: AMC e-Learning Series are multimedia applications written by ActionScript, which are developed for helping students learn English in a digital way. Students can read articles, watch videos, look up words in the dictionary, record and replay their pronouncing, and make a quiz in these e-learning applications.
